name: Hand of Anubis

features.name: Multiplier spots
features.description: Wins mark positions; repeat wins in marked spots create and grow multipliers.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: Multiplier spots persist through free spins.

review: Hand of Anubis is Hacksaw's darker take on an Egyptian cluster game, with persistent multiplier spots in the bonus. It plays a little like a high-volatility cousin of Sugar Rush. The atmosphere is excellent and the bonus can build up dramatically if multipliers land in the right places.
